module "OutputTypeWord.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiOutputTypeWord" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""

  %1 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 2, 3), ParameterName="V", SortPriority=32) : float4 @L9:C9 "V"

  sink %4
